d.ko: Join a world where you design, create and pilot your own air sea rescue service. Release your inner hero as you battle fierce storms out at sea to rescue those in need.
d.en: Join a world where you design, create and pilot your own air sea rescue service. Release your inner hero as you battle fierce storms out at sea to rescue those in need.
d.zh: 加入一个你自己设计、创造和指引海上救援服务的世界。随着在海上与猛烈的风暴搏斗，解救那些需要帮助的人，释放自己心中深藏的英雄。
